title: Hướng dẫn chẩn đoán và điều trị một số bệnh về Răng Hàm Mặt
issuer: Bộ Y tế (Ban hành kèm theo Quyết định số 3108/QĐ-BYT ngày 28/7/2015 của Bộ trưởng Bộ Y tế)

source_path_or_url.download_verified: 2026-11-14: HTTP 200, SHA-256 identical to the local file

license_or_permission.basis: Publicly downloadable professional guideline issued by the Ministry of Health (Quyết định 3108/QĐ-BYT), hosted by a third party (benhvienlaokhoa.vn). No license or reuse terms are stated in the PDF or on the download URL.
license_or_permission.use_in_this_lab: Processed for non-commercial coursework; text chunks are sent to the OpenRouter embedding API. Contains no personal data.
license_or_permission.redistribution: Not verified. The PDF is not committed; obtain it from download_url and check the SHA-256 in 'snapshot'.

extraction.method: page.get_text() default 'text' mode, per physical page

page_counting_rule: Count PDF pages 8-201 (printed pages 7-200): the 57 disease guidelines. Exclude cover, title, editorial board, table of contents, abbreviation list and reference pages. gold_page in the benchmark uses the PDF page number.
known_issues: PDF page 1 (the decision) is a scan with no text layer; OCR'd with EasyOCR and 26 reviewed corrections (handwritten number/date, punctuation, column order).
Font maps 'ư/Ư' to 'ƣ/Ƣ' (U+01A3/U+01A2) throughout; fixed during normalization.
Some words are split by stray spaces (e.g. 'b ệnh'); worse in diseases 8 and 43-47.
Comparison tables (e.g. PDF pages 23-26) are linearized cell by cell.
Short content pages (<200 chars) are section tails, not extraction failures.
ingestion_scope: Ingest the 194 content pages plus the front-matter parts in special_sections (PDF pages 1-7; page 1 via OCR). Front matter is ingested but NOT counted toward the 30-page content minimum. Each special section is one unsplit chunk in every strategy, with disease=null. References (202-208) are not ingested.

special_sections.note: Scanned Quyết định 3108/QĐ-BYT ngày 28/7/2015 (4 articles, signed by Thứ trưởng Nguyễn Thị Xuyên). No text layer: text from scripts/ocr_scanned_pages.py + data/ocr/page_001_corrections.json.
Title page: Bộ Y tế, document title, 'Ban hành kèm theo Quyết định số 3108/QĐ-BYT', Hà Nội 2015.
